title: K/DA: Automated Data Generation Pipeline for Detoxifying Implicitly Offensive Language in Korean

bias_targets.methodology: LLM-based evaluation (G-Eval) and human annotation to assess 'implicit offensiveness', specifically checking if the generated or detoxified text disparages or criticizes groups based on gender using trend-aligned slang.
